extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who want to create a new Wikipedia page (e.g., checking whether an article exists, account requirements, and troubleshooting missing/deleted pages).

rubrics_metrics.name: Check whether the article already exists
rubrics_metrics.description: Wikipedia does not have an article with this exact name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search for the title or check for alternative titles or spellings. Use the search to see if the topic is covered under a different name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or not autoconfirmed, you cannot create new articles. Consider creating an account and meeting the autoconfirmed criteria before attempting to create a page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article as alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot or should not create the article directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed or unsure of notability/format), use the article wizard to prepare a draft or request that another editor create the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing content and incoming links
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for the page title in existing articles and look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify whether content already exists in other articles or whether other pages link to a topic under a different title; this avoids duplication and helps determine the correct title/placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created pages may not appear immediately
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to see recently created pages that are not yet visible due to update delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization and consider creating a redirect from alternate capitalizations or spellings to the canonical page title to improve discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if a page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you find the page missing, consult the deletion log to determine whether it was removed and learn the reasons so you can address issues (notability, sourcing, formatting) before attempting to recreate or request restoration.
